**Implementation note:** Two-asset fixed-weight rebalancing (weight 0.5 is equal weight).

## Description

Assigns equal or near-equal capital weights to assets and periodically rebalances to restore them.

## Where it may fit

Diversified baskets where concentration control and a simple benchmark are desired; rebalancing can harvest contrarian drift but raises turnover.

## Vehicles

Equity ETFs, multi-asset portfolios, retirement portfolios and benchmark comparisons.

## Required data

Total-return prices, asset universe, rebalancing schedule, transaction costs and constraints.

## Caveats

Equal weights can concentrate sector/factor/volatility risk and incur turnover; not equivalent to equal risk contribution.
